# Standards fixtures

These files are external test inputs. They are not generated by document-core and are not MarkText
language specifications.

- `commonmark-0.31.2-spec.json` contains the 652 examples extracted from CommonMark 0.31.2
  `spec.txt`. The spec text is Copyright 2014–2016 John MacFarlane and licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. The
  extraction first entered this repository in commit `dead1f5ee061671a91d4bf7069da3b934d914ca9`.
- `gfm-0.29-spec.json` contains the 672 Markdown inputs from GitHub Flavored Markdown 0.29
  `test/spec.txt`. The spec identifies itself as CC BY-SA 4.0. The extraction first entered this
  repository in commit `68c71cd78a0d98e0e317c6ccd349f55889f91d7c`.

Upstream sources:

- <https://github.com/commonmark/commonmark-spec/blob/0.31.2/spec.txt>
- <https://github.com/github/cmark-gfm/blob/0.29.0.gfm.13/test/spec.txt>

Keep version, source, and license attribution with copied or transformed fixtures. Expected
CriticMarkup results belong in separately reviewed Profile 1 fixtures; parser-produced output cannot
be promoted into this directory as an independent oracle.
